Alexis Mac Allister.note: Allister's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Alexis Mac Allister.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑上。他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Cristian Romero.note: Romero is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Cristian Romero.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Damian Emiliano Martinez.note: Martínez stands out for the patience to read a penalty taker's last movement. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Damian Emiliano Martinez.noteZh: 他的突出特点是耐心判断点球手最后一下动作。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Enzo Fernandez.note: Fernández's edge is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Enzo Fernandez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Exequiel Palacios.note: Palacios's edge is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Exequiel Palacios.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Facundo Medina.note: Watch Medina for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Facundo Medina.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Geronimo Rulli.note: Rulli is defined by staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Geronimo Rulli.noteZh: 他靠在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Giovani Lo Celso.note: Celso stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Giovani Lo Celso.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Giuliano Simeone.note: Simeone's edge is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Giuliano Simeone.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Gonzalo Montiel.note: Montiel is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Gonzalo Montiel.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Jose Manuel Lopez.note: López's signature is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Jose Manuel Lopez.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Juan Musso.note: Watch Musso for staying ready through long quiet spells. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Juan Musso.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。留意他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Julian Alvarez.note: Álvarez is defined by pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Julian Alvarez.noteZh: 他靠带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Lautaro Martinez.note: Martínez's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He attacks the near-post lane before the marker can turn. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Lautaro Martinez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会在盯防者转身前冲向近门柱线路。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Leandro Paredes.note: Paredes's edge is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Leandro Paredes.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Lionel Messi.note: Watch Messi for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Lionel Messi.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Lisandro Martinez.note: Martínez is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Lisandro Martinez.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Marcos Senesi.note: Senesi stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Marcos Senesi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Nahuel Molina.note: Molina's signature is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Nahuel Molina.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择上。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Nico Gonzalez.note: González's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Nico Gonzalez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Nico Paz.note: Watch Paz for receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Nico Paz.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。留意他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Nicolas Otamendi.note: Otamendi stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Nicolas Otamendi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Nicolas Tagliafico.note: Tagliafico's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Nicolas Tagliafico.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Rodrigo De Paul.note: Paul stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Rodrigo De Paul.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Thiago Almada.note: Almada stands out for repeatable technique on dead balls. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Thiago Almada.noteZh: 他的突出特点是定位球上稳定而多变的脚法。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Valentin Barco.note: Barco stands out for delivering the ball without needing much space. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Valentin Barco.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。
